notes.title: Small Update to Version 1.2 and DLC
notes.notes:
Small changes to the latest version.

- The launcher should work now with the aid of a Launcher.bat file.
- Added the additional contents folder that holds the "Thank you" note and will soon hold the short
graphics novel.

notes.title: Fairealm Version 1.2
notes.notes:
[u]Changes[/u]
- Added a Launcher.hta that should allow the user to select witch game
           Fairealm (Base Game)
           Fairealm: Treasure Raids (Mini-Game with purchase of DLC)
           Fairealm: The Boldprun Reactivated (Short Graphic Novel - Coming Soon - with purchase of DLC)
                  Note: The Boldprun Reactivated button should open up a Thank You note (readme.txt file)
- Made a few changes to cutscenes and other images
- Changes item names from regular Berries and Mushrooms to Fairie Berries and Fairie Mushrooms
- Game has a reworked directory to fit DLC.

[b]Important Notes:[/b]
           A. The "Play" button on Steam should run the Launcher.hta app. If the Launcher is not working (all buttons are pressed and no games show up after a few seconds and an error pops up, navigate to your game folder and run the launcher (or games) directly from your directory (or create a desktop shortcut for them)

To go directly to your game folder follow these steps:
       1. Right-Click on the Fairealm game on your Steam Library
       2. Left-Click on "Properties..."
       3. On the Properties window that pops-up, Left-Click on "Installed Files"
       4. Then Left-Click on "Browse..." on the top-right corner
Alternately, you can also:
        1. Right-Click on the Fairealm game on your Steam Library
        2. Hover the mouse cursor over "Manage >"
        3. Left-Click on "Browse local files"
To Create a shortcut of any app to your desktop:
        1. Right-Click on the app or file (should automatically select the file after the Right-Click)
        2. Hover the mouse cursor over "Send to"
        3. Left-Click on "Desktop (create shortcut)

        B. If your saved files are outside of the new directory, when you play the game they might not show up as available. Navigate to the game folder (see steps above) and Copy and Paste your saved files to the "save" file on the inside of the Fairealm game folder (where the Game.exe is)

Thank you for playing Fairealm!

notes.title: Fairealm - Treasure Raids DLC - Now Live!
notes.notes:
Contains:

- A stand-alone Mini-Game (Turn-Based RPG) that continues the story beyond the Forbidden Lands!
- A Thank you note (Should open when the last button on the Launcher is pressed otherwise it is on the game folder -- See Version 1.2 release notes).
- A short graphic novel (The Boldprun Reactivated will be added as soon as it is finished).

At the moment, there is no Cloud-Save or Achievements for the DLC, so keep a copy of the DLC game's "save" file on your computer if you uninstall the game (By default Steam does not delete save files when you uninstall a game, so this is just a friendly reminder)

If you liked the story and would like to see more come your way, the purchase of this DLC would be more than enough to provide your support and it would greatly appreciated!

Thank you for playing Fairealm!

-Quest Moon Studios- ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Coming Soon - Free-to-Play
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

On December 20th, 2024, just before Christmas, the Fairealm game will be free to play!

If you liked the story and gameplay, there will be a purchasable DLC that will allow you to support the developers so that you may embark on more adventures!

The DLC will contain an appreciation note at first, but be on the lookout for a short graphic novel (or novella) that will bring the characters back to where it all started!

For those that have already purchased the game, Quest Moon Studios sincerely appreciates your support!
